Sign in with a sign-in link

To get a sign-in link, ask someone with SSH access to the MMHotline server to run sudo mmhotline people create-sign-in-link --sign-in-email-address ADDRESS with your sign-in email address.

On your computer, run ssh -L 8480:127.0.0.1:8480 YOUR_SSH_HOST with your SSH destination in place of YOUR_SSH_HOST, then open the new link.
